windowTitle: Serial integration regression fix - recovered runtime command differed because the source record dropped dataCompatibility
scope: Fix the next Cloud Qualification fabric failure (run 36646236276, TestLocalFirstApplicationDeploymentQualification): the recovery guard reported 'runtime command differs from its original execution'.
rootCause: services/workspace/internal/launch/application_source.go persists a sourceRecord for recovery. It stored the kind, ids, artifact, descriptor, digest and object ref but not DataCompatibility, which the runtime deploy command carries (runtime.go sets DataCompatibility: source.DataCompatibility). On recovery, record.resolve produced a source with a nil DataCompatibility, so the re-created runtimeCommand differed from the frozen one and the DataLoss guard fired even though nothing the caller controls had changed.
implemented: services/workspace/internal/launch/application_source.go: sourceRecord gains DataCompatibility; record() marshals it when present and resolve() restores it, so the recovered deploy command is byte-equal to the original.

services/workspace/internal/launch/application_source_test.go: TestSourceRecordRoundTripsDataCompatibility proves record->resolve preserves DataCompatibility and that runtimeCommand built from the original and recovered source are proto-equal (the exact recovery guard).
